description: LIVE-1 / F2 regression (melee): the enemy_unit_has_attacked window (INFESTED WAR ZONE, Runt Swarm) must open when the last Gretchin dies in MELEE through the HUMAN defender's AllocationGroupOverlay (auto-allocate OFF — the overlay writes the casualties into GameState before Done sends APPLY_MELEE_SAVES). Fixture ork11e_orks_reactive (P1 Custodes active, P2 Orks), both seats human. Setup privileges in the Custodes' Charge phase: P2's detachment is switched to Runt Swarm; Gretchin Alpha (U_GRETCHIN_C) is cut down to 2 models placed in base contact range of Custodian Guard F, which gets Fights First / charged this turn; P2 has 4 CP; 'Computer allocates wounds' is OFF. END_CHARGE into the Fight phase (Heroic Intervention declined, both Pile In halves ended). The Custodes player picks Custodian Guard F, a Ka'tah stance, assigns every attack to the Gretchin and confirms; the dock's Fast Roll resolves the attacks; the Ork player rolls the saves in the allocation overlay (Roll Saves, Keep Rolls when offered, Auto-pick when offered, Done). Once the Custodian Guard's attacks are over the window opens for Player 2 with INFESTED WAR ZONE on the wiped Gretchin; Use adds a fresh Gretchin unit to Strategic Reserves for 2 CP.

steps.comment: Codex: Adeptus Custodes 11e (WP-C3): loading this Command-phase fixture readied the Custodes (Martial Ka'tah), which would open ka'tah windows (fight_phase_start / unit_selected_to_fight). Not under test here (the cus11e_* scenarios cover them): un-ready the Custodes - replaces the old 'click the Dacatarai stance' step.

steps.script:
GameState.state["factions"]["2"]["detachment"] = "Runt Swarm"
StratagemManager.load_faction_stratagems_for_player(2)
SettingsService.auto_allocate_wounds = false
var cg = GameState.get_unit("U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_F")
cg["flags"].merge({"fights_first": true, "charged_this_turn": true}, true)
var p0 = cg["models"][0]["position"]
var g = GameState.state["units"]["U_GRETCHIN_C"]
for i in range(g["models"].size()):
	if i < 2:
		g["models"][i]["position"] = {"x": float(p0.x) - 60.0 - i * 45.0, "y": float(p0.y)}
	else:
		g["models"][i]["alive"] = false
		g["models"][i]["current_wounds"] = 0
GameState.state["players"]["1"]["cp"] = 4
GameState.state["players"]["2"]["cp"] = 4
SceneRefs.main()._recreate_unit_visuals()
return [RulesEngine.check_units_in_engagement_range(cg, g, GameState.state), StratagemManager.find_faction_stratagem_by_name(2, "INFESTED WAR ZONE")]
